definitions.explanation: A surface or platform forming one level of a staircase.
A degree of proficiency or position in a hierarchy, especially in martial arts or traditional arts.
A section of text or a column in a newspaper.

examples.japanese: ⟦{階段|かいだん}→階段：00782_kaidan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{三段|さんだん}⟦{上|のぼ}る→登る：00660_noboru⟧。
examples.english: To climb three steps on the stairs.

examples.english: I achieved third dan in judo.

⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{段|だん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{並|なら}べて→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。

notes:
COUNTING PATTERNS:
- ⟦{一段|いちだん}→一段：08951_ichidan⟧, {二段|にだん}, {三段|さんだん}...

MARTIAL ARTS RANKING:
- ⟦{初段|しょだん}→初段：28129_shodan⟧ (1st dan)
- {二段|にだん} (2nd dan)
- {三段|さんだん} (3rd dan)
- ... up to {十段|じゅうだん} (10th dan)

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{階段|かいだん}→階段：00782_kaidan⟧ (stairs, staircase)
- ⟦{段々|だんだん}→だんだん：00832_dandan⟧ (gradually, step by step)
- ⟦{段階|だんかい}→段階：04515_dankai⟧ (stage, phase)
- ⟦{段取|だんど}り→段取り：06629_dandori⟧ (arrangement, preparation)

NOTE: In martial arts, {段|だん} indicates high ranks (black belt levels), while ⟦{級|きゅう}→級：noentry⟧ indicates beginner ranks.
